Author:     Roy <me@dwroy.com>
AuthorDate: Mon Sep 28 21:50:50 2026 +0800
Commit:     Roy <me@dwroy.com>
CommitDate: Mon Sep 28 21:50:50 2026 +0800

    combat: random potions simulated by Monte Carlo, always shown to Jev
    
    Roy 2026-09-28. Random potions are no longer fixed-value solver lines.
    
    - Card-choice potions (Attack/Skill/Power/Colorless Potion; Orobic Acid
      takes one of each type): 12 samples of 3 distinct cards from the
      character's (or colorless) Common/Uncommon/Rare pool of that type in
      the game data, uniform; the solver tries each offered card (free this
      turn) and keeps the best line (turn-solver choiceWays).
    - Draw potions (Swift, Clarity, Cure All, Snecko Oil, Gambler's Brew,
      Glowwater, Distilled Chaos, Bottled Potential): 12 shuffled orders of
      the known draw pile then discard pile (Bottled: hand + both piles);
      Snecko's random 0-3 costs sampled too. The solver plays the real
      drawn cards (CardModel drawn/adds/sneckoCosts; "bottled" special).
    - Every sample's line starts with the drink (SolverInput.firstKey).
      The option is "drink now, then re-plan with the real cards": hp_lost
      and damage_dealt as mean [min-max], wins this turn k/N, beats the best
      potion-free line (code's turn score) m/N, the median sample's line as
      the example, and the rollout facts of that median line. Picking it
      drinks and drops any committed line, so the next board is re-planned.
      Seeded per board (deterministic); other potions are not combined.
    - Budget: 400 ms for all random potions of a decision (never below 4
      samples; a slow sample cuts the node cap of the next), subtracted
      from the rollout's 1500 ms. 100 recorded boards: MC p50 25 ms, p90
      302 ms, max 422 ms.
    - Always an option when Jev is asked; a random potion that beats the
      best potion-free line in some sample makes the turn a question. Every
      dry line dying while a sample lives goes to Jev too (least-loss line
      shown next to it). The 10-option cap keeps a slot for each potion
      option (trimForPotionOptions).
    - Unsimulated potions (no model, or no pool / pile to sample): offered
      only under T1 (the best potion-free option loses >= 12% of current HP
      this turn, or dies in a rollout sample; or the fight plan says now)
      as "drink X first: <text>; effect not simulated", no numbers, with
      offered_because. The decision row logs potions.random (samples, ms,
      wins, beats) and potions.t1.
    - tools/potion-mc-measure.ts: cost and exposure on recorded boards.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
